summary: T16-02 passes. All five story checks exit 0: 528 tests pass, lint and overlap are clean on the current manuscript, and `make -C paper` runs the full chain including a clean tectonic PDF build. The extraction module, the six lint rules, the overlap check, the empty record, the Makefile ordering and the README lines all match the contract. I read all of that from source and did not run the unit cases individually. The only deviation is bookkeeping files outside the story's list.

15 .tex files, 0 abstracts, 0 references without an abstract skipped; no run of 12 or more shared words
528 passed, including test_lint_prose, test_overlap_check and test_tex_prose

checks.criterion: make -C paper runs numbers, lint, overlap, test, pdf in order, and the manuscript passes
checks.evidence: Output order is numbers, lint, overlap, pytest, then tectonic. Ends with 'check_log.py: main.log clean'. Makefile:25 is `all: numbers lint overlap test pdf`.

checks.criterion: Shared tex_prose module: comment, math, verbatim, \verb, key-command and TikZ removal; formatting commands kept; ~ reads as a space; both scripts import it
checks.evidence: tex_prose.py:44-122 and the _CodeScanner class. lint_prose.py:42 and overlap_check.py:30 both import it. Line breaks are kept (tex_prose.py:236).

checks.criterion: lint_prose rules a-f, output format 'file:line: rule: text', exit 1 on any finding, no option disables a rule, styles.tex excluded
checks.evidence: lint_prose.py:128-264. Rules b and c run on `extract(keep_tikz=True)`; the others use the TikZ-stripped extraction. `checked_files` excludes figures/styles.tex (tex_prose.py:204). The only CLI option is --root. List rule is skipped only for appendix-*.tex files at the top of paper/ (lint_prose.py:171).

checks.criterion: overlap_check: tokenisation, MIN_RUN=12 constant with no option, maximal runs reported once, missing or unparsable record fails, null abstracts skipped and counted
checks.evidence: overlap_check.py:36 (MIN_RUN), :72-77 (tokens), :80-111 (shared_runs), :138-169 (load_abstracts raises on missing or invalid JSON). Summary line counts skipped nulls (:204-207).
git diff shows the new file with exactly an empty references object

checks.criterion: Tests exist for the listed lint and overlap cases and use tmp_path or strings, with no fixture .tex committed under paper/
checks.evidence: 528 tests pass, with 45+72+53 lint, 42+7 overlap and 46+ extraction cases. Grep shows cases for the allow comment, the missing record and the appendix list exemption. The diff touches no committed .tex fixtures. I did not run the tests before the scripts existed, so the test-first order is unconfirmed.

checks.criterion: README gains one line per new command that ran
checks.evidence: README diff adds lint and overlap entries and updates the `make -C paper` line.

findings.claim: The bold rule matches \bf as a command anywhere, not just in a `{\bf ...}` group. This stays within the stated rule, but it is looser than a group-only match.
findings.evidence: BOLD = \\(?:textbf|bfseries|bf)(?![A-Za-z]). This causes no failure on the current manuscript.
